note: Subject layer (layer 5) for the GOBLIN faction. Keys are runtime art subjects from src/assets/chibi-art-v7.ts: UNIT:GOBLIN:<ROLE> is the Goblin unit of that mechanical role, PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:<ROLE> its interface portrait, CITY:GOBLIN:<level> the camp, and ICON:ACTION:KABOOM and ICON:ACTION:GOBLIN:RALLY (WAAAGH!) the command icons (bead pulp_wars-0ao.14). The plain keys are the classic, player-coloured look (bead pulp_wars-0ao.8, copied from docs/art/factions/GOBLIN.md; the plain naval keys are the first faction ships of bead pulp_wars-w5j.2); the /SCRAP keys are the olive and brown look of bead pulp_wars-3tq.9, retired as too dark; the /LIME keys are the live look, the redesign of bead pulp_wars-wrn.2 (lime, sand and hazard paint), and describe the accepted sprites.

subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT/LIME: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety home-made goblin fireworks cart, clearly bigger than a soldier: a roped bundle of five fat paper fireworks rockets on thin sticks standing up in the cart and leaning forward, paper tubes in red, orange, hazard yellow, blue and green, each with a cream paper cone tip, one fuse lit with a bright spark; the cart is weathered grey-tan planks on two wooden wheels with light grey tin rims; a little goblin with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, huge pointed ears and a pale sand-buff cap leans out of the cart holding a lit match; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a home-made fireworks cart, not a catapult.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT/LIME: Subject: Scrap Buggy, a chunky cute rickety spiky jalopy, wide and low, filling the whole width of the image: a boxy body of bolted light grey tin panels with rivets, two big panels painted hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f, with black diagonal stripes, a big spiked light grey tin ram on the front, four mismatched chunky black wheels with light grey hubs, a crooked tin exhaust pipe puffing a round light grey smoke cloud; a little goblin driver with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a pale sand-buff flying cap and round goggles grips a small steering wheel; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a war buggy, not a cart.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT/LIME: Subject: Troll, a chunky cute giant mossy troll, a huge hulking lump much wider and taller than a normal soldier: pale cream-green skin, colour #cde0b4, on the whole body, the big round belly, the chest and the face, shaded light sage #9dbf80, a big head with shaggy olive green mossy hair and a mossy olive beard, a big nose, small eyes and two cream tusks, very long thick arms, a huge light grey stone club resting on the right shoulder, crossed brown straps with a ring, a pale sand-buff patched hide loincloth, light grey tin wrist bands, a few hazard yellow paint splashes on the shoulder and bands, big bare pale feet, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a friendly giant, not a normal soldier.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER/LIME: Subject: Goblin portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute scrappy little goblin raider: a huge round head with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, lighter #acdc55 on the face and darker #5a9424 shading, two huge pointed ears sticking straight out sideways, a long pointy nose, big cream eyes and a wide toothy grin, a small pale sand-buff leather cap, bare lime green shoulders with a sand-buff strap, the tip of a jagged light grey tin cleaver with a hazard yellow handle; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER/LIME: Subject: Wolf Rider portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little goblin rider with the big head of his light ash grey wolf beside him: bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, shaded #5a9424, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a pale sand-buff leather cap and strap; the wolf has a cream muzzle, pointed ears and small cream fangs; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN/LIME: Subject: Bomb Chucker portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little goblin bomb thrower: a huge round head with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, shaded #5a9424, huge pointed ears, a big excited grin, a dented tin pot helmet painted hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f, with one black stripe and round goggles, pale sand-buff straps on bare shoulders, one big round black bomb with a bright spark held up beside the head; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:GUARD/LIME: Subject: Orc Brute portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute big broad orc: a huge round bald head with fresh leaf green skin, colour #5aa546, lighter #98d975 on the face and jaw, a heavy bare jaw with no beard, two cream tusks, small grumpy eyes, the whole face clearly visible under a small light grey tin cap, a pale sand-buff harness on bare shoulders, the top of a round light grey tin shield with a hazard yellow rim; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN/LIME: Subject: Orc Warboss portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute big bossy orc chief: a huge round head with fresh leaf green skin, colour #5aa546, lighter #98d975 on the face, the face fully visible with a wide open shouting mouth, two cream tusks and angry eyebrows, a small light grey tin helmet sitting high on the head with two big curved cream horns, a pale sand-buff hide mantle with a cream fur collar, a hazard yellow megaphone held beside the face; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT/LIME: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute home-made goblin fireworks cart shown whole: a roped bundle of fat paper fireworks rockets in red, orange, hazard yellow, blue and green with cream paper cone tips, one fuse lit, on a small rickety cart of weathered grey-tan planks with two wheels with light grey tin rims, a little lime green goblin with a lit match; simple shapes and very few details; clearly fireworks, not a missile.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT/LIME: Subject: Scrap Buggy, a chunky cute rickety spiky jalopy shown whole, wide and low: a boxy body of light grey tin panels with two hazard yellow and black striped panels, a big spiked tin ram on the front, chunky black wheels, a crooked exhaust pipe with a light grey smoke cloud and a little goblin driver with bright lime green skin, a pale sand-buff cap and goggles; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT/LIME: Subject: Troll portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute giant mossy troll: a big round head with a pale cream-green face, colour #cde0b4, framed by shaggy olive green mossy hair and a mossy beard, pale cream-green bare shoulders and chest, a big nose, tiny eyes and a goofy underbite with two cream tusks, enormous shoulders, the top of a light grey stone club; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:1/LIME: Subject: a small level-1 goblin scrap camp: two chunky round patched tents of pale sand-buff hide with darker stitched patches, one hut of light grey tin sheets with a hazard yellow painted door, and a crooked grey-tan wooden lookout pole with a small basket platform and no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:2/LIME: Subject: a level-2 goblin scrap camp, clearly bigger than a small camp, with no castle and no stone: big round patched tents of pale sand-buff hide, a hut of light grey tin sheets with hazard yellow painted panels, a riveted light grey tin lookout tower on grey-tan planks with no flag, a chimney pipe with a small light grey smoke cloud, a low spiked tin fence. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:3/LIME: Subject: a large level-3 goblin scrap camp, the biggest settlement, with no castle and no stone: one huge patched tent of pale sand-buff hide with a bare pole, small sand-buff tents, four huts of light grey tin sheets with hazard yellow painted roofs and grey-tan plank doors, three chimney pipes with light grey smoke, a spiked tin fence. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT/LIME: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Goblins, a chunky cute small ramshackle junk-boat seen from the front-right: a lopsided hull of weathered grey-tan planks patched with riveted light grey tin plates, one crooked mast with one big patched pale sand-buff sail with one hazard yellow patch, a small barrel on deck and one paper firework rocket tied to the mast, and a little bright lime green goblin with huge pointed ears peeking over the rail; simple shapes and very few details; silly, never grim.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP/LIME: Subject: Battleship of the Goblins, a chunky cute big ramshackle scrap warship seen from the front-right: a tall lopsided hull of weathered grey-tan planks and riveted light grey tin plates with hazard yellow painted stripes, a tin lookout tower, two crooked masts with big patched pale sand-buff sails, barrels on deck and a rack of paper firework rockets, and a little bright lime green goblin with huge pointed ears; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT/LIME: Subject: Embarked transport of the Goblins, a chunky cute low ramshackle rowing raft seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: brown planks lashed together with rope, patched with light grey tin plates and hazard yellow paint, two crooked oars, a heap of cargo, a short pole with a hazard yellow rag, and a little bright lime green goblin in a pale sand-buff hat at the oars; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT/LIME: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Goblins, a chunky cute small ramshackle junk-boat shown whole from the front-right: weathered grey-tan planks patched with light grey tin, one big patched pale sand-buff sail with a hazard yellow patch, a little bright lime green goblin with huge pointed ears; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP/LIME: Subject: Battleship of the Goblins, a chunky cute big ramshackle scrap warship shown whole from the front-right: grey-tan planks and light grey tin plates with hazard yellow stripes, two patched pale sand-buff sails, a tin lookout tower and paper firework rockets; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
